name: Cat Golf
detailed_description:
Cat Golf is a fresh and exciting action-golf game where you can tee off in all sorts of unexpected places across a city!

The star of the show? A round, adorable cat! The golf course is an Japanese town.

Set off on a laid-back, carefree adventure as you and your cat zip freely through the city!

Unique Action-Golf Experience

In this game, you'll enjoy a completely different kind of golf than the usual.
The cups aren't on neatly trimmed greens—they're in backyards, on rooftops, schoolyards, and even atop towers.
Bounce off shop signs to curve your shots, or use the sloped roofs of houses as launch ramps to reach the goal.

Because the ball is a cat, the entire city becomes your golf course.

Cat-Powered Golf Action

These cats may love to roll, but that’s not all they’re good at.

They can soar across long distances like a powerful driver shot, or launch high into the sky like a bold iron swing.

Use your skills to satisfy their adventurous spirit and send them flying!

A Cast of Charming, Unique Cats

Cat Golf features a wide variety of feline friends, each with their own distinct looks and personalities.

But it doesn't stop there—every cat also comes with unique abilities that add new layers of strategy and open up different ways to conquer each course.

Story Mode

The city is home to many cats, each with their own tale to tell.

In Story Mode, you'll experience special stories where each cat takes the spotlight.

Play through unique courses as the featured cat and discover the hidden lives and adventures of these feline residents—stories us humans could never imagine.

Multiplayer Battle Mode

Enjoy matches with up to four players, using the entire city as your golf course.

When someone sinks a shot, a new cup will appear somewhere else in the city randomly.

Use your surroundings cleverly and find the fastest route to the next cup to stay ahead of the competition.

Each cat’s unique ability can help you find your own way to victory.

Stroll Mode

Take control of your favorite cat and explore the city at your own pace.

Enjoy a relaxed round of action golf while searching for hidden decorations  for cats and secret collectibles.

In Stroll Mode, you might even come across some cats you don't normally see!

Appearance Customization

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock a variety of decorative items like hats, tiaras, and dragon wings.

Give your favorite cat a cute makeover with these fun accessories!

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 / Intel ARC A380 / ATI Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon Vega 56 / Intel Arc 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
